questions.prompt: How many total litres of water flow over Niagara Falls in a single hour?
reasoning: Niagara Falls has an average flow rate of about 2400 cubic metres per second
One cubic metre is equal to 1000 litres, giving 2,400,000 litres per second
There are 3600 seconds in an hour
Multiplying the flow per second by the number of seconds in an hour yields approximately 31,104,000,000 litres

questions.prompt: How many total kilometres do all active passenger cars in the United States travel collectively in a single day?
reasoning: There are roughly 250 million passenger cars in the United States
On average, each car drives about 40 kilometres per day
Multiplying 250 million cars by 40 kilometres gives 10,000,000,000 kilometres
This provides the total collective distance traveled in a day

questions.prompt: How many total individual keys are pressed across all desktop and laptop keyboards manufactured globally in a single year?
reasoning: About 300 million personal computers and laptops are manufactured each year
Each device keyboard features roughly 100 individual keys
Multiplying 300 million devices by 100 keys gives 30 billion physical key components
This estimates the total number of keys produced globally in a year
